note: Our own archived negative results. They are counter-evidence for candidates, never a blanket refutation: each entry names what was refuted, on which image, with which method, and what would re-open it.

results.claim: The path-sensitive UAF engine (V5) produced 0 confirmed candidates on the FW13.52 image; 5 rank-1 and 20 rank-2 candidates were refuted (2 by dominance/convention proofs, 1 left undecided).
results.refuted: single-function free-then-use shapes as evidence of a bug
results.method: CFG path walk over 16,811 functions, manual refutation per candidate
results.reopen_if: a candidate shows a use that no kill dominates AND the release callee is proven to free that object

results.claim: EXIF tag 0x38b9 in the photo path is a genuine defect (DoS) but reachability from an unprivileged context is INSUFFICIENT; PngDec and GIF parsing produced no finding.
results.refuted: the EXIF defect as a privilege-escalation candidate
results.method: offline parser reconstruction plus consumer search
results.reopen_if: a consumer of the affected parser is shown to take attacker-controlled input in a privileged context

results.claim: JpegParser exports 6 entry points with 0 calls from the four consumers examined, so the decoded path is not reachable through them.
results.refuted: JpegParser as a reachable attack surface
results.method: export inventory plus call search in four consumers
results.reopen_if: a fifth consumer or a dynamic dispatch site is shown to call one of the six exports

results.claim: The in_multi/in_mcast object lifecycle on FW13.52 is closed: H1 NOT SUPPORTED.
results.reopen_if: an owner-loss path is found that does not pass through the closed reference chain

results.claim: The ~0xE4-byte stub region at RVA 0x12562f..0x125713 that the afterglow bootstrap would overwrite is live code (227/256 bytes, coherent, no inbound xrefs) -- byte compatibility is not decidable offline because our image is kpatched.
results.refuted: the assumption that the region is padding
results.method: xref scan over the full dump
results.reopen_if: a readback of the 10 target addresses on the console before patching (hardware, out of Sprint 1)
